## Summary of Changes Made:

1. **Added grey background for code/raw text**: 
   - Modified the `show raw` rule in `core.typ` to include a light grey background (`luma(245)`), padding, and rounded corners for better visual separation

2. **Fixed alignment for artifacts and projects**:
   - **Artifacts**: Changed from a 3-column to 2-column layout where the name and tech stack are left-aligned in the first column (with tech on a new line), and description is right-aligned in the second column
   - **Projects**: Modified the layout so tech stack appears on its own line below the project name (left-aligned), maintaining proper visual hierarchy

3. **Added consistent right padding to title icons**:
   - Updated all section title icons (`education-icon`, `experience-icon`, `publication-icon`, `copyright-icon`, `skill-icon`, `award-icon`, `artifact-icon`, `projects-icon`) to include `0.3em` of right padding for consistent spacing

The changes maintain the overall design aesthetic while improving readability and visual consistency. The grey backgrounds help code snippets stand out, the improved alignment creates better visual hierarchy, and the consistent icon padding provides a more polished appearance throughout the document.
